mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(username, password_hash, phone, email) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, phone, email, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, phone, email, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
